description: The buy link for one plan of a quote. Give the quote's quoteId and the plan: its number in the quote, its reference (such as SB-7K3F9Q-2) or its name. The link leads to the insurer's checkout through the broker, so the sale is recorded under the broker's code. The sale is recorded under the broker's code only when the buyer opens the link unchanged.

plan.description: The plan's number in the quote ("1" for the first), its reference, or its plan name.

quoteId.description: The quoteId of a quote, such as SB-7K3F9Q.

name: create_buy_link
title: Create a buy link
